article-forms.title: a, la, an, lan, nan
article-forms.bodyMarkdown:
Kreyòl uses several singular definite markers. The form depends on the final sound of the noun:

- **tifi a**
- **chat la**
- **pen an**
- **chanm lan**
- **plim nan**

Do not try to memorize every sound rule at once. Start by recognizing the correct form in familiar examples.

plural-yo.title: Use yo after the noun
plural-yo.bodyMarkdown:
For definite plurals, use **yo** after the noun:

- **tifi yo** — the girls
- **chen yo** — the dogs
- **liv yo** — the books

The plural pattern is much more regular than the singular forms.

switch-number.title: Notice what changes
switch-number.bodyMarkdown:
Compare:

- **liv la** — the book
- **liv yo** — the books

The noun stays in place. The marker after the noun tells you whether the phrase is singular or plural.
